stance_basis: explicitly represented a group of individuals in favor of construction of the proposed Airport Spur
summary: E. G. Plautz (listed as Edgar G. Plautz in the written submissions roster) appeared at the Environmental Public Hearing and represented a group of individuals in favor of constructing the proposed Airport Spur, indicating a written statement of reasons would be submitted later.
